title: Molecular Gas Along a Bright Hα Filament in 2A 0335+096 Revealed by ALMA
question: What is the distribution, kinematics and origin of the molecular gas in the 2A 0335+096 BCG and its Halpha filament?

evidence.loc: 3.6 Spatial Correlation with X-ray and Halpha Filaments
evidence.quote: Fig. [13](#fig:halpha) shows the H$\alpha$ nebula from (cite: donahue07) overlaid with contours of the CO(1-0) emission.

what.value: cluster total mass within 30 kpc 2.1e12 Msun

evidence.quote: the total mass interior to $30\rm\; kpc$ is $2.1\ensuremath{\times 10^{12}}\hbox{$\rm\thinspace M_{\odot}$}$

recipe.method: CASA pipeline calibration, phase self-cal, CLEAN with Briggs weighting 2; 2015 CO(1-0) block excluded
Spectra from regions fitted with one to three Gaussians, corrected for primary beam and binning broadening
Convert CO(1-0) flux with Galactic X_CO; CO(3-2) via flux ratio 7
Per-pixel single then second Gaussian fits (2 sigma detection); PV slices of set widths
Core-Sersic model of BCG plus Sersic companion fitted with Galfit-M; I/I0 converted to tau, N_H and dust mass
assumptions: Galactic V-band extinction curve, N_H = 2.05e21 tau_V

recipe.method: Hernquist potential infall compared to PV diagram
assumptions: scale length 7.4 kpc from 2MASS R_e; total mass from Main et al. 2015 NFW

evidence.quote: corresponds to a molecular gas mass of $1.13\pm0.15\ensuremath{\times 10^{9}}\hbox{$\rm\thinspace M_{\odot}$}$
$7.8\pm0.9\ensuremath{\times 10^{8}}\hbox{$\rm\thinspace M_{\odot}$}$ is contained in the elongated filament
The central molecular gas component accounts for $3.2\pm0.4\ensuremath{\times 10^{8}}\hbox{$\rm\thinspace M_{\odot}$}$
The total CO(1-0) flux recovered by these observations is $4.8\pm0.6\hbox{$\rm\; Jy\rm\; km\rm\; s^{-1}\,$}$
the nuclear continuum flux is $6.854\pm0.044\rm\; mJy$ in the July 2014 observation

not_stated_but_needed: Line-free channel ranges used for continuum imaging
Image size, cell size, clean masks and threshold
Whether the 2015 CO(1-0) execution was fully excluded from the imaged cube (yes, but flux scale details not given)
Priors/initial guesses for LMFIT Gaussian fits and number-of-component selection details
Hernquist model free-fall parameters beyond inclination 25 deg and offset -200 km/s
Spatial regions' exact box definitions beyond figures
missing_for_reproduction: Clean parameters (mask, threshold, image size, cell)
score_reason: Data public and simple methods, but imaging and region details are incomplete.
rediscovery_reason: Public data, numeric masses and Gaussian fits are redoable.
